_rules: Within one mockup, each FAMILY should appear in only one place. A family groups near-identical shots, and a clip with the still taken from it.
A <video> and its own poster count as one place. A lightbox / drawer / modal that enlarges something already on the page is not a second place.
The club has ~20 usable stills and 13 clips, so a few deliberate repeats are expected; qa/media.mjs lists them so each one is a choice.
Use a still or clip only for what its description says. Never caption a member as a coach, and never name a person in a photo.
